newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly flat ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly flat ahead of long weekend.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly unchanged ahead of a long New Year's weekend, traders said.
"Most traders are in a wait-and-see mode," one trader said.

She said they were not certain on where rates would be when interbank trading resumes on Thursday next week. "Some believe that interest rates will shoot up, while some said they will remain the same since many banks have prepared for the possible tightness."
The one-week PHIBOR fell marginally following the decline in the overnight rate.
